entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • AddApiVersioning with a custom IProblemDetailsWriter breaks both the custom and decorated IProblemDetailsWriter #62186
  • Perf improvement: updates #62185
  • Certificate Forwarding Middleware Does Not Support URL-Encoded PEM Certificates #62182
  • Rendering razor pages / mvc views directly to output stream without buffering #62181
  • [blazor][wasm] preload links are not properly rooted for app start from deep link #62174
    .NET 10 Planning
  • Minimal API Validation throws when DB Context is passed `AsParameters` #62173
  • TlsListenerMiddleware does not use handshake timeout #62172
  • [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-preview.5.25272.110] Fail to launch Blazor-Blogs App with System.InvalidOperationException after retargeting #62171
  • OpenIddict Certification Issue #62170
  • PullFromJSDataStream should be seekable #62169
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #62168
  • Blazor SSR Task throws NavigationException from finalizer thread #62167

Closed

  • System.InvalidOperationException: File length for '...\dist\favicon.ico' is not defined. #61957
    9.0.x
  • AddOpenApi and MapOpenApi() .net9 is generating docs for all the controller in the API. #62184
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-generation, kestrel-hostheader-mismatch #62161
  • C# & MudBlazor requires clicking Submit twice #62159
  • Documentation says "controller", should say "view component" #62163
  • Large File Upload Issue (still) with MultipartReader in ASP.NET Core -8+ #58233
  • Blazor Error Headers are read-only, response has already started #62115
  • Add a `string parameterName` to the `OnParametersSet[Async]` method in Blazor #62135
  • GetAuthenticationStateAsync isn't invoked when navigating using enhanced navigation #61972
  • app.MapStaticAssets() not cache the static file in blazor .net9 #61983

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix bounds check in test code #62180
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Add StringSyntax format attributes to methods and parameters #62179
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Change priority of re-execution handling and allow router to stream `NotFound` contents #62178
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview6
  • Use handshake timeout for Tls listener callback #62177
    area-networking

Merged

  • Remove unneeded version props/V.D.xml elements #62183
    area-infrastructure, 10.0-preview6
  • [main] (deps): Bump dotnet/arcade from 080e393ba794356ef2b743cc89481774c4a26656 to fdcda9b4919dd16bd2388b5421cc5d55afac0e88 #62176
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • [main] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `09ffd00` to `7427a6b` #62175
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Unify the UX of template projects on navigation to non-existing page #62067
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview6
  • Fixes #62163: Fix incorrect summary for CreateViewComponent. #62164
    area-blazor, community-contribution, 10.0-preview6

Updated

  • Move unified validation APIs to separate package #62071
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Respect JsonSerializerOptions casing for property names in validation errors #62036
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Implement IConnectionEndPointFeature in Kestrel's TransportConnection #62162
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
